shared_elements: frontal anthropomorphic face carved in stone
brow ridge continuous with a straight vertical nose
horizontally set eyes and a straight mouth
monolithic, roughly rectangular columnar body beneath the head
justification: Both are monolithic stone sculptures presenting a strictly frontal, block-headed face with a flat crown, a long straight nose descending from a continuous brow ridge, and a horizontal slit mouth atop a rectangular column-like body. The decisive difference is surface treatment and elaboration: A is a dark, highly finished shaft covered with fine incised low-relief motifs (bands, a prominent disc, curvilinear elements) across the torso, while B is a coarse, undecorated pale block whose only articulation is the crudely blocked-out face, with no ornament at all.
